intro.fr: Don't Starve Together se joue en multiworld : les recettes ne s'apprennent plus à la station de prototypage, mais en accomplissant des tâches.
intro.en: Don't Starve Together can be played in multiworld: recipes are no longer learned at the prototyping station, but earned by doing tasks.

text.fr: Klei Entertainment sort Don't Starve Together en 2016.
text.en: Klei Entertainment releases Don't Starve Together in 2016.

text.fr: Don't Starve Together est jouable en multiworld avec le multiworld (multiworld.gg). Au lieu d'apprendre les recettes à la station de prototypage, on les gagne en accomplissant des tâches.
text.en: Don't Starve Together can be played in multiworld with multiworld (multiworld.gg). Instead of learning recipes from a prototyping station, you earn them by doing tasks.
